fields.Property Note:
Property to be sold is located in the HIGHLAND PARK BOROUGH, County of MIDDLESEX,
State of New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 7 EXETER STREET, HIGHLAND PARK, NJ 08904
Being Known as: Lot 9, Block 4111 on the official Tax Map of the HIGHLAND PARK
BOROUGH.
Dimensions: 40X116 AV

The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without fulther notice by publication.

Plaintiff's good faith estimate of its upset price is: $249,414.70.
